reviewer: Claude (independent; Codex round of record scheduled later by the owner)

blocking_findings.message: The native renderer is an opt-in switch (voxy.native.render default false); normally enabled native LoD and normal-play acceptance remain undelivered.

The traversal's renderQueueIndex is incremented unconditionally past renderQueueMaxSize, and prep/cmdgen/cull use it unclamped as sectionCount, indexing buffers sized by renderQueueCapacity=min(sections,200000): out-of-bounds GPU reads/writes once more than 200000 meshed nodes are selected, which the 1<<20-section default (08a9501d, d9ef4af8) makes reachable.

GL's final blit blends SRC_ALPHA/ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA; the native composite pipeline never enables blending, so Voxy's fade is a hard edge and its alpha is written into Minecraft's colour; the judge's exact-RGB rule would refuse the GL-faithful blend. Commit 2fb1737a and the survey claim the blend exists.

non_blocking_findings.message: An exception between beginFrame and endFrame leaves the tracker recording, so the path stops after three problems; after a failed submit the scene is kept although bakery tile/lightmap uploads drained into the dropped command buffer are lost. The injection launch proves continuation, not correct content.
Mesher workers are stopped only by retire(), which no disconnect/level-change path calls; queued tasks can run while the world engine shuts down; stopWorkers can block the render thread up to 10 s.
Static lightmapSeen with per-scene synthetic lightmaps: every rebuilt scene renders its first frames full-bright until the next readback.

Replay accepts 5000 unexplained rendering-disabled skips and a soak cycle whose stage composited zero frames (growth summed across cycles); within-run growth predicate verify.py:3240 and hier_stream_problem:2531 have no detecting test; far requirement floor is one pixel; streaming/vanillaBound/postPass are constant self-reports.
architecture.md:17 and :69-71 still say the native connection is not implemented / does not borrow Minecraft's device; survey claims the composite blends.
Reload/reconnect thumbnails still show floating rock pillars in the sky, unexplained.

safe_for_normal_play_scope: All voxy.native.* flags unset, GL and Minecraft Vulkan, source/offline review; native switch on or default-on: false.

render_gate_judgment: All nine round-27 counterexamples refused at HEAD (exit 1); 57/61 product/pressure/injection/log guards detected (2 equivalent mutants, 2 real untested); two new acceptances: unexplained rendering-disabled skips and zero-composite soak cycle stage.
product_switch_judgment: Switch alone ran 5959 composited frames through every required stage, kill switch and rendering setting honoured (source); remains opt-in; not safe to default on.
failure_injection_judgment: Exemptions are exact and could not hide a second failure (all five probes refused); Voxy keeps compositing 4963 frames after the injected submit failure; content correctness after failure is not judged, recording-window exceptions still disable the path, dropped uploads plausible.
soak_judgment: Four lifecycles, 21 builds, bytes exactly flat per size; gate refuses 2% growth, a missing cycle and 0x0 masking, but accepts a stage that composited nothing in one cycle; run at pressure capacity, not product capacity.
far_world_judgment: Far look draw 3602 independently recounted: 3328 Voxy pixels beyond Minecraft's 2048-block far plane over CLEAR band, all shown, zero violations, reprojection clamped; requirement detected by tests but its floor is one pixel; fade zone never reached.
